limits: Playwright trusted input is not physical keyboard input. Browser-reserved Escape is also verified with a separate owned headed window and OS input.
API-denial/unavailability and IME composition events are explicit fixtures.
All non-GET API requests are blocked before backend writes. No model or sharing request is sent.
WebKit driver evidence is not Safari or physical-device acceptance.
